module: High-level ImGui toolbox (ui_imguiUtils): UI scale change, texture loading, dropdown menu buttons (DropdownButton/Selectable/Select), recursive display of a Lua table as a tree or in key/value columns, a small key/value app, and display of a sampled float with min/max (SampleFloatDisplay). Useful for a modder's ImGui debug tools. Everything goes through ui_imgui; some functions assume the editor is present (editor.uiIconImageButton).
usage:
local iu = ui_imguiUtils
-- in an ImGui callback:
iu.SampleFloatDisplay('rpm', electrics.values.rpm, 0.5, 1)
iu.addRecursiveTreeTable(myTable, '/my', false)
notes: DropdownButton, DropdownSelectable and DropdownSelect call editor.uiIconImageButton when an icon is provided: this requires the editor (global editor) to be loaded.
DropdownSelectable uses imgui.tooltip, defined in imgui_custom_luaintf.
SampleFloatDisplay stores a state per ImGui id (GetID1) in sampleFloatDisplayState and feeds dataTbl on every call without ever emptying it: slow memory leak if used continuously.
CreateSampleFloatDisplay: the PlotLines graph is commented out; only the text is displayed. Right click = reset, PageUp/PageDown = interval ±0.05 s (hover only).
addRecursiveTreeTable: sub-tables with more than 3 elements at depth > 2 are collapsed in a CollapsingHeader. float3 userdata are displayed as float3(x,y,z), functions list their local variables.
renderSubTree uses the global variable noColumns (not defined in the local scope, hence nil): the noColumns option is not propagated to sub-levels.
keyValueTable calls imgui.Columns(2, tostring(k)) with a variable k not defined at that point (nil): the columns id is therefore "nil".
IsWindowHovered expects windowSize as an ImVec2 pointer (windowSize[0].x), not as a plain ImVec2.
changeUIScale multiplies the scale by GetWindowDpiScale() unless the editor is present with the preference ui.general.dpiAware set to false; it writes imgui.uiscale[0] and FontGlobalScale.
The local functions pointToLine, getlocal, testTableRecursive etc. are not exported.

sampleFloatDisplayState.desc: States of the sampled displays, keyed by ImGui id.

changeUIScale.desc: Sets the ImGui UI scale (imgui.uiscale[0]) and the IO's FontGlobalScale, taking the window's DPI scaling into account according to the editor preference.

drawCursorPos.desc: Draws a small red cross (8 px) at a screen position, by default the current ImGui cursor position; used to debug placement.

posX.desc: Screen X; default: window position + cursor X.

posY.desc: Screen Y; default: window position + cursor Y.

texObj.desc: Loads a texture via ImTextureHandler and returns a table usable with ImGui.

returns.desc: {file = file name, path, tex = ImTextureHandler, texId (legacy, do not use), size = size}.

DropdownButton.desc: Displays a button (text or icon) that opens a popup listing DropdownItem items, to be placed below the button or to its right (horizontal).

horizontal.desc: Popup to the right rather than below, items on one line.

returns.desc: See the code: returns false in the observed paths.

DropdownSelectable.desc: Button opening a popup of checkable items (DropdownSelectableItem); right click can open a second menu (itemsRMB).

iconSize.desc: Icon size before UI scaling, 32x32 by default.

DropdownSelect.desc: Dropdown list: the button shows the current item items[selectedItem[0]]; the popup lets you choose another.

items.desc: List of items with label and icon.

excludeCurrent.desc: Hides the current item in the list (inferred from the name).

returns.desc: See the code; false by default.

IsWindowHovered.desc: Tests whether the mouse is inside a given window rectangle (position + size).

windowSize.desc: Size as a pointer: windowSize[0].x / .y are used.

returns.desc: True if the mouse is strictly inside.

displayKeyValues.desc: Displays the key: value pairs of a Lua table; sub-tables become recursive TreeNodes.

CreateKeyValApp.desc: Creates a simple ImGui window with a TreeNode that displays a Lua table key/value.

callback.desc: Called when the TreeNode is open, before display.

keyValueTable.desc: Displays a table in two columns (sorted keys / recursive values).

fullpath.desc: Current path (e.g. '/root'), used for ImGui ids.

highlightCallback.desc: Called (path, key, value) when an item is hovered.

itemCallback.desc: Called (begin, path, key, value) before (true) then after (false) each entry; the return value of the begin call decides whether the entry is displayed.

addRecursiveTreeTable.desc: Displays any Lua value: tables as a tree or in columns, colored booleans/numbers/strings, float3, functions (names of local variables), other types with tostring.

fullpath.desc: Current path; the number of '/' gives the depth.

noColumns.desc: Forces the tree instead of columns.

cell.desc: Displays two texts in two column cells (Text then NextColumn twice).

CreateSampleFloatDisplay.desc: Creates a sampled float display: the returned object has a draw(newValue) method that shows the value sampled every sampleTime seconds, with a tooltip (last, sampled, min, max).

SampleFloatDisplay.desc: One-line version of CreateSampleFloatDisplay: creates the display on first use (key = imgui.GetID1(id)), then draws it with value.

ValueSampler.desc: Internal object returned by CreateSampleFloatDisplay: measures time, stores the sampled value st and the observed min/max.

get.desc: Adds the elapsed time, updates min/max with the sample, and returns the sampled value.

reset.desc: Resets min/max, sampled value and time to zero.
